intent: The ball rolls down the ramp, speeds up, and comes to rest on the floor after a small bounce.
Textbook diagram: the pendulum is released from the drawn position and swings back and forth, slowly losing amplitude.
Textbook diagram: the block oscillates horizontally on the spring, which stretches and compresses with it.
The windmill blades spin steadily around the hub while the tower stays still.
The stick figure waves hello with the raised arm, with a little bounce in the body.
The fish swims across the frame from right to left, wagging its tail; the bubbles drift upward.
The rocket shakes on the pad with flickering flames, then launches up and out of the frame.
Logo intro: the sun disc scales up from nothing, the rays pop in one by one around it, then the whole logo settles with a gentle pulse.
Logo animation: the heart beats twice (quick double pulse) and the highlight glints.
Logo animation: the cloud drifts in, the lightning bolt strikes down with a flash, and everything settles.
The ball drops from where it is held and bounces three times, each bounce lower, squashing on impact and stretching as it falls, then rests on its shadow.
The minute hand sweeps one full turn while the hour hand advances by one hour; both turn about the center, and the face stays still.
The flower sways gently in a breeze, bending from the base of the stem, while the petals flutter slightly.
Textbook diagram: the cannon recoils slightly as the ball is launched; the ball follows the drawn dashed arc and lands at the mark.
The bird flaps its wings and flies from left to right out of the frame, bobbing up and down with each flap.
The car drives to the right and out of the frame, its wheels rolling in step with its speed and the body bobbing slightly.
Logo intro: the star spins in from nothing with a small overshoot, the inner star pops in, then the center sparkles once.
Logo intro: the three wave stripes draw on from left to right one after another, then the finished logo ripples gently once and settles.
Newton's cradle: the raised left ball swings down and strikes the row; the right ball swings out and back, and the exchange repeats while the middle balls stay nearly still.
The two meshing gears turn in opposite directions; the small gear turns faster in proportion to its size, and the teeth stay meshed without passing through each other.
The ball rolls right into the first domino; the dominoes topple one after another in a chain, and the last one falls flat.
The cat crouches, leaps in an arc onto the box, lands with a little squash, and sits on top.
A three-beat story: the cloud drifts over the sun and the scene dims, rain falls from the cloud, then the sprout grows taller and its bud opens into a flower.
